candidate.blueprint_topic: Management of Care — team leadership and collaboration
candidate.educational_objective: Use respectful, nonstereotyped teamwork practices with a multigenerational clinical team.

options.A: Assign fixed communication styles based on each employee's generation.
options.B: Promote mutual respect and support across different backgrounds and use team diversity as an asset rather than relying on generational stereotypes.
options.C: Avoid collaboration between age groups to prevent conflict.
options.D: Assume workers of the same age share identical values and learning preferences.

candidate.rationale: AHRQ TeamSTEPPS emphasizes mutual support, respect, communication, and the effective use of diverse team members. Predicting behavior from generational stereotypes is not a reliable teamwork strategy.
candidate.source_claim_supported: Effective teams support mutual respect across differing backgrounds rather than assigning predictable preferences by generation.
candidate.source_locator: Emerging Team Challenges — workforce/team diversity; mutual respect and support
candidate.source_organization: Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality (AHRQ)
candidate.stem: A nurse leader is managing a team whose members differ in age, background, and work experience. Which approach best supports effective teamwork?
